newsitem.title: JAPAN: Tokyo stocks end higher but hurt by financials.
newsitem.headline: Tokyo stocks end higher but hurt by financials.

text.p: Tokyo stocks closed modestly higher on Wednesday, but recent bullishness in blue-chip issues was watered down by concerns over Sumitomo Trust & Banking Co Ltd's equity financing, brokers said.

News that the central government and local governments were removing Nomura Securities from their lists of bond underwriters and suspending other business with it weighed down the brokerage's share price, though the impact was limited, they said.
The Nikkei 225 closed up 80.61 points or 0.40 percent at 20,209.72. It hovered narrowly between 20,030.10 and 20,209.72.
